title: Pinecrest baggage handling weekly status
brief: I run baggage operations at Pinecrest Airport and I need the weekly status page for the week ending 2026-10-30, for terminal managers who will read it on their phones during the morning walk-round. Headline numbers: 241000 bags handled, a mishandled rate of 5.9 per 1000 bags against a target of 6.5, first bag on the belt in 14 minutes against a target of 15, and belt uptime of 99.2 percent. Under "Mishandled rate trend" chart the rate per 1000 bags for eight weeks: W37 7.1, W38 6.8, W39 6.6, W40 6.3, W41 6.0, W42 5.8, W43 6.2, W44 5.9. Under "Terminals" give a table of bags handled and mishandled rate per 1000: Terminal 1, 98000, 4.9; Terminal 2, 92000, 5.7; Terminal 3, 51000, 8.4. Under "Needs attention": Terminal 3 is the outlier, because belt 4 jammed on 2026-10-26 and again on 2026-10-28, and a scanner at its transfer point is failing to read 1 in 12 tags. Under "Next": a new tag scanner for Terminal 2 goes in on 2026-11-09, belt 4 gets a new drive on 2026-11-03, and the peak holiday plan is signed off on 2026-11-12.

edit.request: Add W45 at 5.6 to the trend, change the headline rate to 5.6, and move the Terminal 2 scanner date to 2026-11-16.
